messages:
Aisha: Heads up - Vendor 'StratusGrid' sent invoice SG-998 for $9,750 but it's missing a PO number. Vendor says it's for the quarterly support renewal. We need to match before month-end.
AP Bot: Invoice SG-998 uploaded. Status: Pending PO match. Routing to finance queue.
Carl: We used to have PO RWD-2022-455 for StratusGrid but that was closed. No active PO in Coupa.
Mina: Contract reference is `SUP-STR-2023`. Legal confirmed renewal terms but didn't see an addendum with an implementation line.
Tomas: The invoice includes a $1,500 "onboarding/setup" line that isn't in the signed renewal SOW. We should either get credit or a corrected invoice.
Aisha: Can Purchasing create a new PO and route for approval? Budget owner is @Maya (cc @Accounting).
Carl: I can create PO RWD-2024-940 and attach to the invoice, but approver on the vendor profile is outdated (Leah left). Need backup approver.
Mina: Maya is OOO until Friday. Her backup is @Tomas - he can approve up to $12k.
Tomas: I can approve once AP confirms whether the $1,500 is valid. Please request vendor to clarify line item.
Aisha: Messaged StratusGrid rep Elena: "Please confirm if onboarding fee is billable per SUP-STR-2023 or will you issue a corrected invoice/credit?"
StratusGrid (via email): "We'll issue a corrected invoice removing the $1,500 onboarding fee by EOD tomorrow or provide a $1,500 credit memo."
AP Bot: Invoice SG-998 status updated: Pending PO match -> Waiting for vendor correction. Ticket FIN-5782 created.
Accounting: Noted. If credit is issued, accruals for this month will change. Please tag month-end reports.
Tomas: Once corrected invoice or credit is attached I will approve PO RWD-2024-940. Marking as high priority for close.
Aisha: Thanks all - keeping thread open until resolved.
